class nvitk.cluster.StageSpec¶

A single SGE-submitted pipeline stage.

python_cmd is the literal command run inside the Singularity container. Host paths referenced inside the command must fall within the bind mounts defined by ClusterPaths and SingularityBinds.

job_name: str¶
python_cmd: str¶
resources: SgeResources¶
binds: SingularityBinds¶
extra_env: dict[str, str]¶
use_nv: bool = True¶
extra_host_binds: tuple[tuple[pathlib.Path, str], Ellipsis] = ()¶
nvitk.cluster.build_qsub_command(spec: StageSpec, paths: ClusterPaths, *, hold_jid: str | Sequence[str] | None = None, array_tasks: int | None = None, task_concurrency: int | None = None) → list[str]¶

Build the qsub argv for spec.

When array_tasks is set, emit -t 1-N (and optional -tc) with per-task log/err paths using SGE’s $TASK_ID.

nvitk.cluster.build_singularity_command(spec: StageSpec, paths: ClusterPaths) → str¶

Wrap spec.python_cmd in singularity exec with the standard binds.

Injects a small BLAS/OMP thread-cap preamble (NSLOTS / NVITK_CPU_LIMIT, capped at 64) before extra_env exports so OpenBLAS/MKL never spawn unbounded threads on fat SGE nodes (avoids known segfaults).
